Implemented `refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Validates and rounds the amount, rejecting non-positive amounts with `BillingError("non_positive_amount", ...)`.
- Requires `payment.status == "captured"`, otherwise raises `BillingError("invalid_state", ...)`.
- Rejects refunds exceeding the remaining captured balance with `BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", ...)`.
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount`, sets status to `"refunded"` when fully refunded, records an audit event, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, and edge cases were verified manually.
